image.caption: A harvest mouse investigates the foliage at Almond Valley heritage centre in Livingston, West Lothian. The mice — the size of a 20p piece — are classed as critically endangered in Scotland
Performers take part in the opening gala of the sixth ethnic minority art festival in Beijing. President Xi and other leaders were among the audience in the Great Hall of the People
The Caldor fire sweeps through the Eldorado National Forest in California. It has destroyed almost 300 square miles of land since it started on August 14
The calm seas around the Minquiers, a group of islands and rocks off Jersey, allowed Jason Masterman to capture this shot of his daughter, Cicely
Workers examine the 200-year-old wooden lantern and belvedere on top of Beckford's Tower in Bath. Repairs are under way on the 154ft grade I listed building
Boys attending the first day of school at a cadet lyceum in Kiev, Ukraine. September 1 in Ukraine is Knowledge Day, which marks the traditional launch of the academic year
Fabrics are hung on bamboo poles to dry in the sun at a factory in Bogor on Java Island, Indonesia

Protesters from Extinction Rebellion rest at a bus stop opposite the business and energy department in central London. The group is staging two weeks of demonstrations in the capital to demand action on climate change
The Hogs Back brewery has a new helper for the hops harvest in Tongham, Surrey. Sovereign is a Suffolk punch, the oldest English breed of working horse
A walker needs sunglasses in Windsor, Berkshire, on the first day of meteorological autumn
The actress Scarlett Johansson features among celebrity portraits in The Photograph, a new book by the British photographer Andy Gotts
A visitor takes part in Every Wall is a Door, an immersive exhibition staged by the artists Es Devlin, James Turrell and teamLab at the Superblue Miami museum in Florida
